abstract: This study was performed to characterize MR findings of struma ovarii. In 10 patients, T1- and fast spin echo T2-weighted MR images were obtained in the axial, coronal, and sagittal planes using 1.5 T MR units, and they were retrospectively evaluated for the site, size, components, signal intensity, and contrast enhancement.MR images showed a unilateral complex mass with a multilobulated surface and thickened septa, corresponding pathologically to thyroid follicles and the stroma. Cystic portions had variable signal intensities on T1- and T2-weighted images. The contents of cystic components showing low signal intensities both on T1- and T2-weighted images were viscid gelatinous materials (n=4). Solid portions were relatively well-enhanced. In conclusion, struma ovarii has some characteristic MR appearance of a multilobulated complex mass with thickened septa, multiple cysts of variable signal intensities, and enhancing solid components.
abstract_ja:
卵巣甲状腺腫のMRI所見を検討するため、10例を1.5T MR装置で評価した。T1強調像と高速スピンエコーT2強調像を軸位、冠状位、矢状位で撮像し、部位、大きさ、成分、信号強度、造影効果を後方視的に評価した。
MR画像では、多小葉状の表面と肥厚した隔壁を有する単側性の複雑な腫瘤が認められ、病理学的には甲状腺濾胞と間質に相当した。嚢胞部の信号強度は多様であった。T1強調像とT2強調像の両方で低信号を示す嚢胞成分の内容物は、粘稠なゼラチン様物質であった(4例)。充実部は比較的良好に増強された。
結論として、卵巣甲状腺腫は、多小葉状の複雑な腫瘤、肥厚した隔壁、信号強度の異なる多発嚢胞、増強される充実成分という特徴的なMR像を示す。
